annotation.authors_or_issuer: AUDA-NEPAD (African Union Development Agency), with Ministère de la Transition Digitale du Burkina Faso, Niyel, CITADEL
annotation.summary_en: AUDA-NEPAD web page announcing guidelines for ethical, inclusive and responsible AI in francophone Africa, developed under Burkina Faso's digital ministry with Benin, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea, Mali and Senegal. Covers ethical principles, data governance and sovereignty, inclusion, capacity building, research and funding, regional cooperation, and monitoring. The guidelines themselves are a downloadable file.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines developed by six francophone African countries under Burkina Faso's leadership
Aligned with Agenda 2063 and the AU Continental AI Strategy
Cover ethics principles, data governance, privacy and digital sovereignty
Call for inclusion, non-discrimination and institutional capacity building
Promote active, value-based AI governance rather than passive technology adoption
annotation.title_clean: Lignes directrices pour une Intelligence Artificielle éthique, inclusive et responsable en Afrique francophone
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for ethical, inclusive and responsible Artificial Intelligence in Francophone Africa
